note: BH-10218 (BH-9926 second round): settings row lane.scheduler.gh_source. Where the scheduler's stack parent lookup (sw_parent_pr, one pulls?state=all&head= read per parent) reads: the record answers only an OPEN parent that is in the trusted open list; a branch not in it is the miss field:head and reads GitHub. off = GitHub only (today's read); shadow (default) = the PR record and GitHub, the lane acts on GitHub and logs one PRR_SHADOW line in logs/prr-shadow.log when they differ; record = the PR record (a miss reads GitHub and logs PRR_MISS). Any other value is shadow plus one PRR_STEP line. Seam: bin/lib/prr-shadow.d/scheduler.sh. Move to record only after a 48-hour shadow count of 0 (docs/notes/2026-11-26-BH-10218-small-lanes-reads.md).
